verdict.rationale: Browsing files, commit history, and blame in the web UI is a fair question for a code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a web file browser, commit history view, or line-by-line blame. The nearest items are download/clone/fork options (github-docs-50) and Copilot 'explore your repositories' messaging (github-docs-73). Both are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.
